主要内容: The document titled 'l11506k.htm' is a Form 6-K filing by Royal Bank of Canada, published on January 19, 2016. It outlines the issuance of $1,250,000,000 in 2.500% Senior Notes, due January 19, 2021. The filing includes various legal opinions and consents from Sullivan & Cromwell LLP and Norton Rose Fulbright Canada LLP regarding the validity of the notes and tax matters. The report is incorporated by reference into the Bank’s Registration Statement on Form F-3 (File No. 333-208507). The filing is signed by James Salem, Executive Vice-President and Treasurer of Royal Bank of Canada.
